outcome: Total oxidant capacity (TOC) in amniotic fluid
Total antioxidant capacity (TAC) in amniotic fluid
Oxidative stress index (OSI) in amniotic fluid
cohort: 25 patients diagnosed with placental abruption and 25 healthy controls undergoing cesarean section
finding: Patients with placental abruption exhibited significantly higher oxidative stress and inflammation in their amniotic fluid compared to healthy controls, suggesting a potential role for these factors in placental abruption pathogenesis.
gest_age: Lower in the abruptio placenta group
birth_weight: Lower in the abruptio placenta group
